In all the years I ran an antivirus, it never found or stopped a single virus on my computer. In the years since I stopped using an anti-virus, I've never had a virus or any other type of malware.

How is this possible? Because I practice safe computing. I avoid questionable sites and questionable downloads. I don't double click on links. I have Java, scripting, and Java Script turned off in my browsers. I run a firewall. I have everything in Windows I don't use turned off or disabled. I turn off all unnecessary functions in my browser and other software. I'm more or less up to date on Microsoft security fixes.

If I ever suspect I may have malware, I download and run stinger and malwarebytes. So far, they have always come up negative.

Point I'm making is that nobody really needs antivirus software. What they need is safe computing habits.
